attchmntText: Star Paper Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Star Paper Mills Limited has announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 14th Nov., 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th Sept., 2026. The company has enclosed the Unaudited Financial Results and the Independent Auditors' review report by the Statutory Auditors with this communication. The meeting commenced at 5:00 PM and concluded at 5:15 PM. This information is submitted pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations for the National Stock Exchange and BSE.
